_comment: LAYER 3 — the Planner's prelude. HAND-CURATED GAME KNOWLEDGE, edited by a
person and never inferred, exactly like `zone_eras.json`, `split_mobs.json`
and `reuse_debuffs.json` beside it. This is the 'everybody does this first'
list with a reason on each line, and it is what makes the Outline read as
though somebody who played the expansion wrote it: the wiki files
`Sokokar Timeline` as a peer of `Kylong Plains Timeline`, and nothing in
any field anywhere says to do it first.
Every entry is a claim about the GAME, so the only rule is that a person
has to agree with it. `page` is checked against the crawled catalog and a
miss is REPORTED by tools/sync_planner.py rather than hidden — a prelude
line whose page went away is a line to fix, not a line to drop.
Fields: title, why (the because, on the same line as the entry), detail
(the practical note under it), page (a wiki page to link), zone, level,
kind (travel|levelling|access|raid|epic|crafting). Order in the file is
the order on the page — this list NEVER reorders itself.
Seeded 2026-08-15 from the wiki's own timeline pages. It is deliberately
short: the design calls for 15-25 RoK entries and the rest are Lindsay's
to add, because the ones worth having are the ones you only know from

rok.title: The sokokar post network
rok.why: Do this first — every other line on this list gets shorter.
rok.detail: Adventure 65 OR tradeskill 65, either one alone. Both versions start at Dreg's Landing in Kylong Plains: Borbin Happens for adventurers, Jones for crafters. You only ever need one of the two.

rok.title: Kylong Plains, then Fens, then Kunzar, then Jarsath
rok.why: The expansion's spine — the zone timelines are the level path through Kunark, in that order.
rok.detail: Kylong Plains 68-73, Fens of Nathsar 70-75, Kunzar Jungle 74-78, Jarsath Wastes 75-80. Each one's own page names the next.

rok.title: Your class's epic weapon
rok.why: The level-80 signature line, and the biggest single upgrade most classes see in this expansion.
rok.detail: One timeline per class ('Paladin Epic Weapon', 'Warden Epic Weapon' and so on), all of them level 80. Its steps run through the raid zones, so it overlaps whatever else you are doing in them.

rok.title: Raid flagging: the Rise of Kunark progression
rok.why: Only one quest in it is a real access quest — the rest is lore, and knowing which is which saves a night.
rok.detail: Starts with The Fate of Norrath in Kunzar Jungle at 80. Taking on Trakanon is the visible access quest for Veeshan's Peak; access to the other raid zones comes from the KILLS, not from the quests.
rok.page: Rise of Kunark Raid Flagging Timeline

rok.title: The tier-1 raid targets carry the keys
rok.why: Each of the three drops the item a later kill needs, so the tier-1 zones are not optional and are not just gear.
rok.detail: Imzok's Revenge (The Protector's Realm) gives The Greenmist Orb, which you need to kill The Leviathan. Tairiza the Widow Mistress (The Tomb of Thuuga) gives the Mistmyrian Soulcube for Venril Sathir. Pawbuster (The Execution Throne Room) gives Isydryl's Wand of Intervention for Overking Selrach Di'Zok.
rok.page: Rise of Kunark Raid Flagging Timeline

rok.title: The artisan epic, if you craft
rok.why: Level 80 tradeskill line out of Bathezid's Watch — it is also the other way into the sokokar network.
rok.detail: Starts with New Lands, New Profits. Doing the crafting version of the sokokar line first is the usual advice when your adventure level is below the zone.

eof.title: Greater Faydark, Butcherblock, Steamfont, Lesser Faydark, Loping Plains
eof.why: The Faydwer level path, in order — each timeline page names the next one.
eof.detail: Greater Faydark 1-20, Butcherblock 20-35, Steamfont 35-50, Lesser Faydark 50-60, Loping Plains 60-70. Crushbone Keep (20-30) and Kaladim (30-40) hang off Butcherblock as the heroic branches.

eof.title: The Cloak of Flames
eof.why: The expansion's famous cloak, and it is heroic rather than raid — most groups can finish it.
eof.detail: Juna Crankfizz in Butcherblock Mountains runs the whole line; it opens on a collection quest, so start the collection early. Levels 65-70.

eof.title: The League of Freethinkers, for the Relics of the Past
eof.why: The heroic line that ends in The Blackwater Mask — the reason to hold faction with the League.
eof.detail: The Hand of Glory (65) and Dom of the Elani (67) are heroic; The Blackwater Mask (70) is epic.

eof.title: Swords of Destiny
eof.why: The expansion's signature questline and the one everything in Mistmoore's story leads to.
eof.detail: Runs through Crushbone Keep and The Acadechism.
